svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Components sheet 1, alternative C: State matrix
svg.desc: State matrix of the Key entry, preset swatch, hex field, all button kinds and the toast action across default, hover, focus, pressed, disabled and error; the colour popover in four states; toast and confirm variants; Settings at wide and narrow widths. Real size, synthetic data.
svg.text: Every interactive piece in every state it can be in, at real size.
Read across for states, down for components. “—” means the state does not exist.
DESIGN.md and EXPERIENCE.md win on conflict
Proposed: hover and pressed colours are not in DESIGN.md yet (primary hover #363C42, pressed #000; outlined hover = ground, pressed = band).
Focus is the fixed ring everywhere: white gap + ink ring on paper, dark + white on the ink toast. Disabled stays focusable and says why.
